what: Settings framework: three-layer config (defaults.json private → .aide/config.json public overrides → pro gate). Each setting has {value, public, pro} metadata. public:false = users can't override. To promote: flip public to true. To make pro-only: set pro:true. Shared read-config.sh function reads defaults, checks if public, checks user override, checks pro flag. All 16 settings start as public:false. Implement as part of current batch alongside hook defaults optimization.
why: User wants settings framework that makes it easy to promote individual settings from private to public to pro-gated. Needed before implementing the 16 configurable defaults.
